title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: The main subjects are the following three: 1. Practice in self-analysis and career design 2. Search for self-future direction with making to improve in job consciousness by expert-lecture sessions and factory inspections, etc. 3. Initiate activity with planning in the subjects required for a long period on the written exams of qualification acquisition, general common sense, and SPI, etc.
advice: The class is carried out by a course unit. 1. Advice of career design and self-development 2. Grasp the basic ability level and overcome the weaknesses in electrical and electronic engineering (Integrated practice) 3. Aware of self-characteristics (advantages and disadvantages) and self-appeal 4. Lecture by expert working on -Attendance and whole discussions- 5. Research on companies 6. Research on business and industries related with electric occupations 7. Research on business and industries unrelated with electric occupations 8. For my career design -Integrated practice and whole discussions
requiredKnowledge: It is due to perform the career planning seminar I carried out at the current fiscal year towards job-hunting activities of next year, and to make the preparation and strategy to the severe job-hunting expected. All students need to take a lecture irrespective of a future direction, because it is necessary to make preparations of mental attitude and employment exam for job-hunting activities. Moreover, this study result serves as reference data of the employment placement in next year.

activityGoals.body: The relation between a life design and a career path can be considered deeply for your own self.
Thinking and action required in order to discover a suitable life path for yourself can be performed.
Your life plan and target can be drawn up yourself.
Knowledge, capability, and qualification required to achieve a life path are investigated.

achievementLevels.ideal: All the Program objectives can be attained.
achievementLevels.standard: 75% or more of the Program objectives can be attained.

lessons.content: - Guidance on this class - Advice of career design and self-development (lecture and discussion)
lessons.operation: - Distribution of Future employment note - Arrange and submit your idea
lessons.assignments: - For the availability of the qualifications in connection with your career design.

lessons.content: - Efforts towards to conquest of weak points while having grasped the level of basic ability in electrical and electronic engineering (Integrated study).
lessons.operation: - The past employment exam problems are solved, self-weak points are clarified, and efforts towards conquest by each one.
lessons.assignments: - Major subjects etc. are reviewed in order to conquer your weak points.

lessons.content: - Aware of self-characteristics (advantages and disadvantages) and a means of self-appeal
lessons.assignments: - Arrange to aware of self- characteristics, study the effective self-appeal method in advance.

lessons.content: - Research on business and industries related with electric occupations (lecture and exercise) (1)
lessons.operation: - List up the company groups which got interested in the lecture, and the reasons are summarized.
lessons.assignments: - List ten or more companies where you get interested related with electric occupations. - Narrow down several companies and examine the reasons in advance.

lessons.content: - Practice tests for employment selection examin ations
lessons.operation: - Understand the importance of business information collection for your career design. - While reviewing this lessons so far and grasping self-advantage and weak points, the weak point compensation methods are examined.
lessons.assignments: - Meaning of business information collections is explained and practical demonstration and exercise are performed. - Reviewing this lessons so far and self-weak point compensation methods are submitted.

lessons.content: - Research on business and industries related with electric occupations (lecture and exercise) (2)
lessons.operation: - List up the company groups which got interested in the lecture, and the reasons are summarized.
lessons.assignments: - List ten or more companies where you get interested related with electric occupations. - Narrow down several companies and examine the reasons in advance.

lessons.content: - Lecture and whole discussions to deepen the understanding on "get a job" - Self-Assessments
lessons.operation: - Based on the questions collected in advance, discussions are performed with questioners. - Then, the uneasy feeling and doubt over getting a job are clarified and the understanding is deepened.
lessons.assignments: - Summarizes "question and doubt points through the course" in advance.
